title: Part sale line lookup does not offer an inactive part
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user (Admin) · 1 browser · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Part Lifecycle QA build (no build exists yet; use the build named in the test run).
  • User: [Admin] = you, signed in with the Admin role, which by default has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete' and See Financial Data.
  • Location: [Loc-1] = the location picked in the top-bar location switcher at the start; every step runs at [Loc-1] unless it names another location.
  • Data: [Part-A] = one tracked part, quantity 4, set inactive in Setup. [PS-1] = an open part sale for [Cust-1] with no parts.
  • Names and numbers marked (e.g. …) are examples only. What must hold is the status (active or inactive), tracking, quantity and link described above.

Setup

  1. Go to Parts → Inventory, click "New Inventory Part" and fill in Description (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL PSLOOK PART), Part Number (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-PSLOOK-01), Category (e.g. Uncategorized), Cost (e.g. $10.00), Sell Price (e.g. $20.00); leave "Track quantities and cost of goods" on; set the default bin's Quantity to 4; click Save.
  2. [Part-A] = the part number you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST-PL-PSLOOK-01); [Desc-A] = the description you typed (e.g. ZZAUTOTEST PL PSLOOK PART).
  3. Go to Customers, create a customer named (e.g.) "ZZAUTOTEST PL PSLOOK Customer" and save it. [Cust-1] = that customer.
  4. Go to Parts → Part Sales, start a new part sale for [Cust-1]. [PS-1] = the part sale number shown (e.g. P2-89).
  5. Set [Part-A] inactive: on the Active tab search [Part-A], click its row, pick Part Status "Inactive", click Save, leave the note empty and click "Deactivate" in the "Deactivate part?" confirmation.
  6. Check the setup worked: [PS-1] opens with an empty Parts tab; [Part-A] is on the Inactive tab only.
custom_steps:
1. Open [PS-1] and its Parts tab.
  2. Click "Add Part".
  3. Type "ZZAUTOTEST-PL-PSL" in Part Number.
  4. Close the part row without saving.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: No row for [Part-A] is offered.
  • Step 4: [PS-1] still has no parts.
